facts.text: Faena Hotel Miami Beach is at 3201 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140.
facts.excerpt: 3201 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140, United States

facts.text: Los Fuegos by Francis Mallmann celebrates South American live-fire cooking with an asado experience.
facts.excerpt: Celebrating the ancient art of South American live-fire cooking, revered grillmaster Francis Mallman tames the elements for an authentic asado experience.

facts.text: Every Sunday, Los Fuegos holds a Sunday Asado of gaucho open-fire grilling.
facts.excerpt: Every Sunday, experience the time-honored tradition of gaucho open fire grilling at Los Fuegos by Francis Mallmann's Sunday Asados.

facts.text: Pao by Paul Qui fuses Filipino, Spanish, Japanese and French flavors into contemporary Asian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Fusing Filipino, Spanish, Japanese, and French flavors, Pao creates a bold and visionary brand of contemporary Asian cuisine.

facts.text: El Secreto Omakase is a speakeasy-style omakase curated by James Beard award-winning chef Paul Qui.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in an ultra-exclusive speakeasy-style Omakase experience curated by James Beard award-winning chef Paul Qui.

facts.text: The Living Room is a late-night jazz bar in a golden-age glamour style.
facts.excerpt: Intimate and inviting, steeped in the style of golden-age glamour, this late-night jazz bar seamlessly marries classic and contemporary elements.

facts.text: Tree of Life & Sun Bar is a secluded garden setting with cocktails plus lunch and dinner options.
facts.excerpt: Indulge and unwind in our secluded garden oasis with imaginative cocktails and enticing lunch and dinner options.

facts.text: Obsession at Faena Theater has performances every Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
facts.excerpt: Performances every Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.

facts.text: Tierra Santa Healing House is a 22,000-square-foot wellness space on the hotel's third floor.
facts.excerpt: Set on the third floor of the hotel, our 22,000-square-foot wellness haven harmoniously blends ancient practice and cutting-edge technology.

facts.text: Daily yoga and meditation are held at Tierra Santa Studio.
facts.excerpt: Balance the mind, challenge the body and elevate the spirit with daily yoga and meditation at Tierra Santa Studio.
